_help: Fill in every value that starts with REPLACE, then run: python3 scripts/build-legal.py. Change 'version' whenever the wording or these details change in a way users should re-accept; the app then asks everybody to accept again.
service_name: REPLACE: the name customers know the product by
company_name: REPLACE: your legal or trading name
contact_email: REPLACE: an address people can write to (and that you read)
country: REPLACE: country whose courts decide disputes
governing_law: REPLACE: for example the laws of England and Wales
supervisory_authority: the data protection authority in your country
hosting_region: REPLACE: the Render region of the service, as shown in the Render dashboard
log_retention: REPLACE: how long Render keeps logs, for example 7 days
refund_policy: REPLACE (only used once paid_plans is true): your refund rules, for example: Fees already paid are not refunded, except where the law requires it or we agree otherwise.
